&= 1 - \sum_{b = 2}^{m+1} \sum_{q = 1}^{\frac{n-b}{2}} (-1)^{n-q} \\
&= (-1)^n \cdot (-1)^{b+1} \sum_{q = 2}^{m} (-1)^n \left(\frac{n - q}{2n} + \left\lceil \frac{n - q}{2n} \right\rceil^{m-1} \right) \\
&= (-1)^n \left( \frac{n}{6}(m+1-m) - \sum_{q = 2}^{m} (-1)^m \left( \frac{n - q}{2n} + \left\lceil \frac{n - q}{2n} \right\rceil^{m-1} \right) \right) \\
